description: Return the representative-entry table of current state-of-the-art quantum computers (id, hardware type, physical qubit count, 2-qubit error rate, connectivity class with a note on the coupling graph, source URL). Same data that powers the website's "Current Quantum Computers" table. The model's capability prediction per entry in QUOPS units is served by compute_expectation (hardwareContext.currentQuantumComputers[].modelCapability); measured scores are in list_quops_scores.

title: Current Quantum Computers
